threshold.note: slopes: PR-8 judged along-terrain dwt; both dw and dwt reported; thermals 0.1 m/s from the PR-12 task

regions.domain: All fluid cells (cell type 1) of the case, halo excluded; includes the side and top sponge layers.
regions.launch: Fluid cells in the R1 `crop` window (16x16 columns around the launch, as in export_ongudai.py:check_field), up to 400 m above terrain (check_field takes all levels; the pilot layer is below 400 m).
regions.agl_10_50: Fluid cells whose centre is 10 <= h < 50 m above the terrain height hc of the column (centre z = z_bot + (k+0.5)dz).
regions.agl_50_100: Fluid cells whose centre is 50 <= h < 100 m above the terrain height hc of the column.
regions.agl_100_200: Fluid cells whose centre is 100 <= h < 200 m above the terrain height hc of the column.
regions.agl_200_400: Fluid cells whose centre is 200 <= h < 400 m above the terrain height hc of the column.
regions.thermals: Fluid cells 10-400 m above terrain, outside `slopes` columns, where the REFERENCE w >= 0.75 m/s (about the 99.3rd percentile of w of the mechanical u3_mech case in the same cells; heat cases have ~3x more such cells, so the region is the strong-updraft cores, thermals in heat cases). Same rule for every case; mech has mechanical updrafts there.
regions.slopes: Fluid cells 10-400 m above terrain in columns with terrain slope norm(grad hc) >= 0.3 (central differences on the 400 m grid, ~17 deg; upper quintile of Ongudai columns, median 0.22). The lowest fluid cell (agl < 105 m) has w = 0 by the staggering, so raw dw there is 0; `dwt_*` adds the along-terrain term u*hx + v*hy.
